# ARGUS System Design draft3 failure snapshot

The Runtime Controller coordinates Candidate Selection, Analysis, Contradiction Engine, Allocation, Risk Validator, Decision Queue, Notification Router, Canonical Writer, Provider Adapter, External Service Gateway, Budget Gate, Time Gate, Backup Manager, Restore Manager, Audit Logger, Incident Manager, and Human Interface.

処理は候補を探索し、複数の分析を統合し、提案を作成し、検証を行い、通知し、人の判断を待ち、結果を保存する。

Paper Trading を行う。通知時間は規則に従う。
